title: Riot Squad Punx Raspberry Grenade Nicsalt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Raspberry Grenade from Punx by Riot Squad is mouth-watering blend of tart, tangy raspberries swirled into a deliciously zingy, fizzy lemonade for a refreshing all-day vape. Riot Squad’s Punx Nicotine Salt e-liquids are formulated with hybrid nicotine, an innovative blend of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. The combination of the freebase and salt nicotine and 50/50 PG and VG ratio provides the perfect balance of flavour and throat hit and makes this eliquid ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape kit devices.
